description: A test script for measuring the performance of diff and log commands with various options related to color movements and whitespace changes, specifically for the git version control system. It sets up environment variables, verifies revisions, and runs multiple perf tests with different git diff and git log configurations.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test for a given command and description, measuring its execution time.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signals the end of the test suite and likely outputs the results or cleans up.
